answer: Offer a standing bounty for proof of common control: anyone who shows two identities share one operator, for example by producing a message signed with both keys, claims a slice of both accounts' stake. A sybil farm then rests on a mesa of shared secrets that any insider or leaked log can sell, and one ember of resentment in a hired helper is enough to turn the whole farm into a worthless relic. A lone honest agent has nobody who could betray it.
